channel.title: Bollam Rishithej — Writing
channel.description: Notes on deep technology, company building and corporate governance.

item.title: The one-office rule, and what it does to a founder's board map
item.description: Section 203 of the Companies Act lets a person hold exactly one whole-time key managerial office. That single constraint shapes how a multi-company founder is allowed to sign.

item.title: Why lab-grade chemistry had to leave the laboratory
item.description: The bottleneck in water, soil and food testing is almost never the chemistry. It is the journey the sample takes to reach it, and the days that journey costs.

item.title: A camera is not perception
item.description: Most organisations already own the sensors they need. What they lack is anything that converts a wall of live video into a decision somebody can act on.
